title: "rungar providers drain"
description: "Disable a provider, and wait until its runners are gone"
---

Disable a provider, as disable does, and wait until the last runner on it has gone. It lasts until the daemon restarts, which goes back to what the configuration says: set disabled there to make it last.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar providers drain NAME
```

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
